title: $L_p$ Brunn-Minkowski inequality for weighted dual quermassintegrals
summary: We investigate the $L_p$ Brunn-Minkowski inequality for dual quermassintegrals in weighted measure spaces, which is a special class of rotationally invariant measures proposed by Cordero-Erausquin and Rotem [Ann. Probab., {\bf 51} (2023)]. Specifically, the weighted dual quermassintegral is defined by integrating the radial density $|x|^{q-n}φ(|x|)$ for $q\in(0,n]$, where $φ$ is a positive radially non-increasing weight, it recovers the classical dual quermassintegral when $φ\equiv1$.
